note: Chippewa NF (Deer River district) campground in 200-year-old red and white pines on the west shore of Clubhouse Lake, about 8 miles east of Marcell off MN-38 (County Road 45, then 3 miles of Forest Road 2181). Swim beach, accessible fishing pier and day-use area at the water. OHVs may only ride in and out of the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 232149 read: 47 sites (28 reservable, 19 FCFS), $16, back-in driveways 30-80 ft, vault toilets + hand pumps, season May 22-Oct 31 confirmed, 4-day reservation cutoff, all FCFS after Labor Day. rec.gov tags 002 and 005 Lakefront -> lakeview candidate.
flags: WATERFRONT (contrary claim, not waterfront stored): the recreation.gov catalog marks sites 002 (47.61018,-93.57594) and 005 (47.61065,-93.57437) 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'; both are reservable nightly sites. On imagery 005 is about 25 m from the shore under continuous pine canopy (a view); 002's point falls at the edge of the open day-use swim beach, about 15-25 m from the water, but its pad cannot be resolved under the trees and the open sand is the public beach, not the site. Proposal: not waterfront -> lakeview (two named view sites); lakefront on 002 only if a photo shows its pad on open ground at the beach. Every other placed site is 60 m+ back in the pines.
